title: Structural Properties of the Köthe Dual of the Matricial Bloch Space
summary: We study the Köthe dual $\mathcal{B}(D,\ell_2)^K$ of the matricial Bloch space. A 2015 conjecture [Publ. Math. Debrecen \textbf{87} (2015), 351--370] proposed that this space coincides with the dyadic mixed-norm space determined by the operator norms of the diagonals. We disprove the conjecture by revealing a structural obstruction: membership in $\mathcal{B}(D,\ell_2)^K$ is sensitive to the placement of the entries within the diagonals and cannot be detected from diagonal data alone; in particular the trace-norm variant fails as well.
